$comment: Shared project settings for AI agents on AI Personal CFO. Checked into git so every contributor's agent shares the same safe defaults. Personal overrides go in settings.local.json (git-ignored). Permissions allowlist common read-only + build commands so agents aren't prompted for routine work; anything not listed still prompts. See CLAUDE.md for the binding rules.
$notes: deny reads target signing/secret material (SEC-001/007): agents should never load keystores or service credentials into context. If a real secret path differs, extend the deny list rather than relaxing it.
